ante_bet.effects: Xtra-Bet™ raises Base Bet by 50% (total cost 1.5× bet). Wins are evaluated on the Base Bet amount, not the Xtra-Bet amount. Cannot be combined with Fast Track™. Increases the chance of triggering the Free Spins bonus (exact chance multiplier not captured for this title).
